problem_statement:
Homepage renderer config-schema registry

## Problem

The organizer JSON editor and seed engine cannot safely accept per-renderer
config until one server-safe registry validates each section type.

## Acceptance criteria

- Add one pure/server-safe registry mapping each config-editable
  `HomepageSectionType` to its parser/validator and documented accepted shape.
- Renderer parsers are the single source of truth; do not duplicate a looser
  validation schema in organizer code.
- Reject dangerous prototype keys, non-JSON values, excessive depth/size, and
  a type without a registered validator. Return a null-prototype shallow-frozen
  normalized config.
- A renderer may remain displayable before it becomes config-editable; missing
  validator means fail closed, not pass-through.
- Focused `.test.ts` covers every registered type, registry/type drift,
  malformed nesting, prototype keys, size/depth limits, and parser equivalence
  with RED/GREEN mutants.

## Dependencies and boundaries

Land only after the milestone renderer contracts/parsers stabilize; a single
integration captain owns the registry hot file. No schema/migration, UI, seed,
Production, secrets, spend, pricing, or legal work. Parent: #1851.
